effects: The signer sends _value USDT from their balance to _to.
An owner-set fee (basisPointsRate, capped by maximumFee) goes to the owner and is taken out of _value. It is 0 in the source defaults, and the mined tx shows the recipient got the full amount.
formats.shown: Intent "Send" with the amount in USDT and the recipient address.

findings.title: transfer field 'To' limits addressName types to eoa, but the code accepts contract recipients too.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transfer field `#._to`: "types": ["eoa"]; TetherToken.sol BasicToken.transfer: `balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(sendAmount);` has no restriction on the kind of address.
findings.fix: Set "types": ["eoa", "contract"] on the 'To' field, or remove `types`.

findings.title: transfer shows the full amount, but an owner-set storage fee could cut what the recipient receives.
findings.evidence: TetherToken.sol BasicToken.transfer: `uint fee = (_value.mul(basisPointsRate)).div(10000); ... uint sendAmount = _value.sub(fee);`. setParams lets the owner change basisPointsRate. It is 0 today, and in case 0 the recipient got the full 29175501426.

cases.notes: 29175.501426 USDT out to 0x1d79...0193, the same as the receipt.

effects: The signer sets the spender's USDT allowance to _value, replacing the old allowance (the call reverts if it changes one non-zero value to another).
formats.shown: Intent "Approve" with the spender address and the amount in USDT; amounts at or above 2^255 show as Unlimited.

cases.notes: An allowance of 29990.860783 USDT to 0x1231...4EaE, the same as the receipt.
